title: Stop Doing This At Highway Exits (Part 2)
hook: Part 2! Never brake inside this lane.

script.narration: Part 2! Never brake inside the deceleration lane until you are completely out of the main highway flow.
Maintain your highway speed inside the merge lane first, then brake smoothly only after you are fully off the main lanes.
script.visual_search: driver foot pressing car brake pedal

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this? Comment yes or no, because you should...

description:
Part 2 of our Highway Exit Safety series. Master the correct speed management technique once you enter the exit lane to prevent rear-end collisions.

why_it_will_work: Directly continues a successful series requested by the subscriber base, fulfilling the exact promise made in Part 1.
quality_problems: fact-check: Confusion between deceleration lanes and merge lanes. The script tells drivers to brake inside the merge lane, which is incorrect and dangerous.
